documentation.content:
Host memory utilisation is sustained high.

The production app container is capped at 1 GB with a single replica, and background workers run INSIDE that web process (src/instrumentation.ts), so a memory spike from document parsing or a transcode competes directly with request serving. An OOM kill takes both down and stops every sweep until the container restarts.

**First response:** `docker stats` to identify the container, then check whether a large document upload or video transcode is in flight — those buffer whole files.

NOTE: the filter pins state="used". This metric emits one series PER STATE (used, free, cached, buffered, slab_*), and the condition reduces with MAX across series — so without the state pin, a mostly-idle host with free memory above the threshold would fire this alert continuously, reporting memory pressure at exactly the moment there is none.
